description: This PHP class, ChannelResourceTransformer, extends an abstract transformer class and provides methods to transform and retrieve information related to a channel resource model, including displaying a title, image, and actions based on user permissions.

classes.name: ChannelResourceTransformer
classes.description: A class that transforms channel resource models for display or further processing, providing methods for getting info, images, and actions.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns a formatted HTML string containing the title of the resource.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the link to the resource's image, or the image itself if no link is available.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns an array of actions (like edit, translate) available for the resource based on user permissions.
